document_id: Cavaleri 2019 - The October 29, 2018 storm in Northern Italy – An exceptional event and its modeling

impacts.description: The crest of the largest expected wave (7.90 m) reached the damaged structure suspended below the tower deck n. 2, whose nominal height on mean sea level is 8.40 m.

evidence.quote: The height reached by the crest of the largest expected wave (7.90 m) is compared to the height of the damaged structure suspended below the tower deck n. 2.
